items.caption: The Shuowen seal-script form of 歲, analyzed as 从步戌聲 (步 with 戌 as phonetic). This is a later lexicographic analysis; early forms have competing explanations.
items.alt: Black seal-script rendering of 歲, with a compact upper section above a larger, complex lower section.
items.selection_reason: The visible form illustrates the specific seal-script analysis recorded in Shuowen, while the cited accounts make clear that it does not settle the graph’s disputed early formation.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector rendering of a seal-script form, not an ancient artifact image. Early forms have competing explanations, and the available accounts do not establish a single original formation or a continuous path from early uses to later senses.
